This is accomplished by dragging Fleeting Manifestations to their cell doors and then killing the manifestations when they have 80 or more energy. They will then leave a pool behind that will be big enough to kill the captives.

Formulated Courage is an item that is made with Khaz Algar Alchemy. Alchemists can drink this item to remove the debuff Recent Catastrophe after Wild Experimentation has failed, allowing them to instantly try again instead of waiting 10 minutes for the debuff to end. The recipe for this item is learned after spending 30 Profession Knowledge Points in the Alchemical Mastery specialization.

Fortune's Fall is an airship crash site in southwestern Hallowfall. The kobyss have taken over the wreckage. The area is bordered by the exterior Priory of the Sacred Flame to the north, the Veneration Grounds to the east, Morgaen's Tears to the south, and the Undersea to the west.

Four Warband Mentors: The War Within is a characters achievement earned when four characters reaches level 80 on an account. The Warband Mentored Leveling buff will now provide an additional 20% to experience gains up to level 80.
Forsaken Warlock are Forsaken found in Sanguine Grasps in Hallowfall. They are fighting against Xal'atath's Kaheti nerubians during the defense of the Aegis Wall.
Forsaken Warriors are projections that appear during Story Time in Tanaris. They appear in The Mercy of Baine Bloodhoof.
The Foul Bursting Chomper is a mandragora located in the Thornmire in Tanaan Jungle during certain bugged phases. It will occasionally eat a nearby plant, granting a temporary poison cloud around it.
Four of Ascension is a crafting reagent that is a rare drop in content. It is part of the Ascension Deck.
Four of Radiance is a crafting reagent that is a rare drop in content. It is part of the Radiance Deck.
Four of Symbiosis is a crafting reagent that is a rare drop in content. It is part of the Symbiosis Deck.

Founder's Point is an Alliance-themed neighborhood zone. It features biomes resembling the idyllic landscapes of Elwynn Forest, the pastoral farmlands of Westfall, and the haunted forests of Duskwood. Its Horde-themed counterpart is Razorwind Shores.

Fortified Arcanocrystal Shard is a Legion: Remix artifact trait that appears multiple times throughout the tree. The cost increases as you go deeper into the tree, scaling from up to . The first instance of this trait increases stamina by 9%; all others increase it by 13%.
Fortuitous Satchel can be looted from the Pristine Mysterious Satchel during the Winds of Mysterious Fortune.

Four Warband Mentors: Midnight is a character achievement earned by reaching level 90 with four characters. The Warband Mentored Leveling buff will now provide an additional 20% experience through levels .

Forsworn Champion are kyrian located in the Gardens of Repose in the Spires of Ascension.

The Founders Point Bulletin Board is located next to Lyessa Bloomwatcher at the Town Center in Founder's Point. Fortune's Waving Cat is available from the China-exclusive Lunar New Year Adventure event.
